period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/standalone (Union Bank PLC has no subsidiary; consistent with the bank's Q4/annual reporting basis already established in this dataset). Shariah-based Islamic bank: reports 'Investments' not 'Loans and Advances'. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'CONDENSED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited) For the Period (Q-1) ended 31 March 2022' -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK's quarterly filings in this dataset. Because this is Q1, the cumulative and discrete-quarter figures are identical by definition. Source PDF ('Quarterly-Financial-Statement-as-on-31-March-2022.pdf', filed with a 'Date: 28 April 2022' signature block) extracted cleanly with pdftotext -layout (a genuine text-layer PDF, not scanned) -- no OCR needed. Balance-sheet identity reconciles exactly: Total Liabilities (233,628,709,268) + Total Equity (14,624,754,599) = Total Assets (248,253,463,867). P&L chain reconciles exactly: Total Operating Income (1,474,398,874) - Total Operating Expenses (681,860,051) = Profit before Provision and Tax (792,538,823); - Total Provisions (151,500,000) = Total Profit before Tax (641,038,823); - Tax (300,000,000) = Net Profit after Tax (341,038,823). This report's own December-2021 comparative column matches this dataset's stored FY2021 annual figures (Total Assets 242,418.20m, Total Liabilities 232,407.67m, Equity 10,010.54m) exactly -- no restatement. This quarter's own filing supersedes an earlier interim filing for the same date superseded by a bonus/rights context: paid-up capital jumped from BDT 5,589.34m (Dec 2021) to BDT 9,869.34m (Mar 2022) mid-quarter, consistent with this dataset's existing note that Union Bank's IPO/DSE listing occurred 26 January 2022 (i.e. during Q1 2022). NAV per share (14.82) is cross-validated exactly against Union Bank's own 2023 Q1 interim filing, which separately reproduces 'March 2022' as its prior-year comparative NAV figure. The condensed quarterly filing does NOT disclose classified investments, NPL ratio, or CRAR/capital-adequacy figures (Basel-III capital note is absent from the condensed interim format) -- these appear only in the audited Annual Report; not available for any Q1-Q3 period in this dataset.
